title: 25 FOR REASONS — Board 000
dek: A college-football poll with receipts, one public reason per team, and no deleted preseason takes
body:
PointCast 25 begins with one defined question: if everybody played next Saturday, which 25 teams would we believe in most?

Every rank carries a case, a doubt, and the next proof required. Tuesday boards preserve the exact reason for every movement. Sunday marks each live claim as proof, complication, or death. Thursday names three games capable of changing the board. Saturday becomes a quiet watch order for people with one good window, not another endless score feed.

Board 000 opens with Ohio State, Notre Dame, Texas, Oregon, and Georgia. Defending champion Indiana begins at No. 6—not as disrespect, but as the season's first falsifiable question about continuity.

The ranking and its receipts remain public. A one-time $25 Founding Season Ticket backs the 2026 editorial season; hosted checkout handles card entry and receipts away from PointCast.
